description: This file defines the Order model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, responsible for interacting with order-related data in the database, including retrieving individual orders, multiple orders, product details, options, subscriptions, totals, histories, and counts of various order-related records.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: A model class that provides methods to retrieve and manipulate order data from the database within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific order by order ID, including payment and shipping country and zone codes.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of orders for the current customer.

methods.name: getOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of orders associated with a specific subscription ID.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific product within an order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches all products associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Fetches options associated with a specific product in an order.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves subscription details for a specific order product.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Retrieves total amounts and other total-related records for a specific order.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves historical status updates and comments for an order.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the count of history records for a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByProductId
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders containing a specific product.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByOrderId
methods.description: Returns the total number of products within a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders associated with a specific subscription ID.
